WITH track_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    t.MediaTypeId,
    mt.Name,
    CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS byte_rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
),
media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    Name,
    AVG(byte_rate) AS media_type_rate
  FROM track_rates
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(media_type_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT 
  mtr.Name,
  mtr.media_type_rate,
  mtr.media_type_rate - oa.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_rates mtr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mtr.media_type_rate > oa.avg_rate
ORDER BY mtr.Name;
